item.title: To the Editor | ANA Michigan
item.description: I am writing to express my unequivocal stance against any narrative or assertion that nursing is not a profession. Such claims are not only unacceptable but also a direct affront to the centuries of dedication, education, and contributions that nurses have made to healthcare and society.
